text:
katie: Quick thread to lock down Q3 private-onramp acceptance for a customer pilot. Scope: per-tenant reserved slots, prewarm path, KMS decrypt at boot, fallback routing. Target: 6 weeks. Who can own what?
mike: Runtime can prototype serialized KV restore + lightweight weight priming. Proto estimate ~8 business days. Need perf targets and an API shape.
oliver: Infra: region-us-west2 has limited spare. We can carve 6 soft-reserved slots immediately; hard reserves need node add (~3w). Need a clear fallback rule.
yasmin: Security: KMS decrypt required for pilot. HSM optional. Need audit schema + rotation policy. ETA to scope: 5 business days.
katie: Product suggests minimal acceptance: 1) warm p95 < 250ms for short prompts, 2) fallback to hosted <=3% under normal load, 3) key decrypt at boot + 30d audit retention, 4) billing tags emitted. Agreed?
mike: Agree. I'll aim for p95 < 200ms in staging and post a perf harness. Config draft tonight.
oliver: Fallback: router prefers private, falls back when reserved_util > 85% for >12s. We'll emit reserved_pressure metric and fallback_count. Product pick allowed fallback %.
yasmin: I'll post an audit schema; require per-key unwrap logs with tenant id, ts, request id. Also flag any compliance blockers early.
katie: Owners: runtime = mike (proto + perf harness), infra = oliver (carve slots + metrics + fallback), security = yasmin (KMS checklist + audit schema), product = katie (acceptance tests + customer comms). Add ETAs?
mike: Runtime owner ETA: 2 weeks for proto, +1 week for validation.
oliver: Infra owner ETA: carve 6 slots by Apr 12, metrics + fallback by Apr 16, node add if needed by May 3.
yasmin: Security owner ETA: Apr 10 for checklist and audit schema.
katie: Let's schedule a 30-min handshake Fri 9am PT to confirm API shapes, perf targets, fallback thresholds, audit retention, and rollback criteria. infra-bot: Meeting created: "Private onramp pilot handshake" Fri 09:00 PT invites: @katie @mike @oliver @yasmin.
katie: I'll update the roadmap ticket with owners and dates and tag the customer. Ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
